data.title: Did IREN’s Pivot From Bitcoin Mining to AI Cloud Deals Just Shift IREN's (IREN) Investment Narrative?
data.description: In the past month, IREN Limited reported its fiscal 2026 results and highlighted a transition of its sizable Bitcoin-focused data center capacity toward AI compute workloads, underpinned by new multi-year AI Cloud agreements and ongoing contract expansions with major customers including Microsoft. This shift suggests IREN is repurposing existing infrastructure to pursue recurring AI cloud demand, potentially reshaping its mix between digital asset mining and higher-value compute...
